headline: Newark is lagging under low clouds; the other hubs are running normally.

items.text: The FAA has a ground delay program for flights into Newark (EWR) until 11:59 PM ET because of low clouds. Those flights are held at their departure airport, with delays averaging 105 minutes and up to 214 minutes.
Of the seven United hubs reporting so far today, Newark is lowest at 67% on time (left within 30 minutes of schedule), and it is the only one under 70%. The other hubs are running normally.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Newark, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
